book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: عيلتنا كانت فقيرة، وكل الأمل بعمي جول.
sentences.en: Our family was poor, and all our hope was in my uncle Jules.

sentences.ar: كان سافر لأمريكا وبعت مكتوب إنه صار غني.
sentences.en: He had gone to America and written that he had become rich.

sentences.ar: أبوي كان يقرا المكتوب لكل ضيف بيجي.
sentences.en: My father used to read the letter to every guest who came.

sentences.ar: وكل مرة نشوف مركب بنقول: بلكي هو.
sentences.en: And every time we saw a boat we said: perhaps that is him.
One day, we went on a small sea trip.

sentences.ar: كان في رجل عجوز بيفتح المحار للركاب.
sentences.en: There was an old man opening oysters for the passengers.

sentences.ar: أبوي تطلع فيه طويل وشحب وجهه.
sentences.en: My father looked at him a long time and went pale.

sentences.ar: راح على الكابتن وسأله عنه بهدوء.
sentences.en: He went to the captain and asked about him quietly.

sentences.ar: الكابتن قال: هاد مسكين، اسمه جول.
sentences.en: The captain said: that is a poor wretch, his name is Jules.

sentences.ar: أمي قالت: لا تقربوا منه، ولا تحكوا.
sentences.en: My mother said: do not go near him, and do not speak.

sentences.ar: أنا رحت أدفع له تمن المحار.
sentences.en: I went to pay him for the oysters.
I put the money in his hand and looked at his face.

sentences.ar: رجعنا بمركب تاني عشان ما نشوفه.
sentences.en: We came back by a different boat so as not to see him.

sentences.ar: من يومها، ما حدا ذكر اسم عمي جول.
sentences.en: From that day, nobody mentioned my uncle Jules’s name.
